				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>The Hotel Orkos Beach is situated in the bay of Mikri Vigla approx. 50 m from the beach and 10km to the south from of Naxos town. The bay with its Crystal blue water has a wonderful sandy beach and invites also ‘no-kiters’ for a sunbath.</p><p>The newly built hotel lies in a nice garden with a swimming pool and provides double rooms, studios for 2-3 people and apartments for up to 4 people. They have a bathroom with shower, air condition and TV and the studios have also a kitchenette.</p><p>All of them have nice spacious terraces, most of them with seaview.</p>								</div>

				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p><strong>General Policy:</strong></p><p>Check-in time: 2:00 PM <br />Check-out time: 11:00 AM</p><ul><li>Kids up to 5 years old free of charge together with 1 or 2 adult in double room.</li><li>Baby cot in room free of charge</li><li>Breakfast time: 8 &#8211; 10 am</li></ul><p><strong>Rate Information:</strong><br />Rates are in euro (€) and include Greek breakfast with organic &amp; local products and all applicable taxes.</p><p><strong>Payment Policy:</strong></p><p><span style="font-size: 16px;">30% of the total amount of the reservation needed. This amount is kept as a deposit and is refunded in case of early cancellation.</span></p><p><strong>Cancellation policy:</strong></p><p>In case of cancellation 30 days before arrival the deposit is paid back to the customer. Any cancellation less than 30 days before arrival the full deposit is charged. In case of cancellation during the stay, a 50% compensation of the remaining days originally agreed is due and payable by the customer.</p><p><span style="font-size: 16px;">In case of no-show the hotel may charge 100% of of the total price of the reservation. For any further information or help please contact us at: <a href="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection" class="__cf_email__" data-cfemail="ef82868c878a838aaf8983869c99809cc284869b8a8c8a819b9d8ac18c8082">[email&#160;protected]</a></span></p>								</div>
